## Closes

Link the issues this PR closes on merge. Delete this section if it closes none.

IMPORTANT: GitHub only applies a closing keyword to the FIRST issue in a
comma-separated list. Repeat the keyword before every issue number, one per
line, or the extras stay open:

  Good (all close):
    Fixes #1
    Fixes #2
    Fixes #3

  Bad (only #1 closes; #2 and #3 stay open):
    Fixes #1, #2, #3

Keywords: close / closes / closed, fix / fixes / fixed, resolve / resolves /
resolved. Issues can also be linked under "Development" in the sidebar.
